place_fields.micro_region: Dargah Shahi Mohalla, Kuvempu Nagar, Kolar
place_fields.summary: A clock tower landmark on MB Road in Kolar's Dargah Shahi Mohalla area.

planning_attributes.description: Clock Tower is located on MB Road in Dargah Shahi Mohalla, Kolar.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Use MB Road and the Dargah Shahi Mohalla area of Kolar as the local approach reference.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Expect an urban roadside setting with traffic around the landmark.

place_fields.summary: A Hindu temple listed in Kolar near the Parashurama Swamy Temple area.

planning_attributes.description: The place is listed as Ancient Lord Shiva Temple in Kolar and is associated geographically with the Parashurama Swamy Temple area.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Approach via the Kolar town area toward the Parashurama Swamy Temple near Kolar Town Lake.
planning_attributes.notes: Identity is retained as supplied because the available map listing does not establish a more specific historical temple name.

place_fields.summary: Avani is a historic temple village in Kolar district known for its ancient temple group and Sita-associated traditions.

planning_attributes.description: Avani is a village in Mulbagal taluk of Kolar district; the Ramalingeshwara group of temples there is an early medieval heritage complex.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The Ramalingeshwara group at Avani is associated with the Nolamba period, with later Chola additions; Avani is also associated in local tradition with Sita, Lava and Kusha.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Avani is about 32 km from Kolar and about 13 km from Mulbagal, making Kolar or Mulbagal the practical road approach references.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The wider Avani attraction area includes a hill, so visitors should allow for uneven or sloping walking surfaces.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied map title is kept as Avani Temple; the documented heritage complex in Avani includes the Ramalingeshwara, Lakshmaneshwara, Bharateshwara and Shatrugneshwara temples.
